features.title: Group a thread workspace's changes into review scopes
features.summary: Read the current thread workspace's jj diff against its base bookmark, group the changed files with pulls.review's deterministic rules, and review one scope at a time with locally persisted progress.
failureModes: A missing workspace, a workspace without a jj repository, no resolvable base bookmark, or a missing jj binary is reported with its own reason instead of an empty diff.
jj stderr never reaches the client; a failed command is classified, not quoted.
A patch larger than the Host cap is flagged as truncated rather than silently shortened.

externalDependencies.boundary: The jj CLI in the resolved thread workspace.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The e2e journey provisions a disposable jj repository; unit tests inject a scripted jj runner and check the real CLI output separately.

verification.testName: groups changed files with pulls.review rule-based scopes and exact stats
reads the first resolvable base bookmark and groups the diff
reports a missing base, a missing workspace and a missing jj without leaking command output
groups a real `jj diff --git --from main --to @` into scopes
separates the same path across workspaces and revisions
